title: Default daily brief improved but still missing canonical CoS sections
summary: User ran another default daily briefing test. The response improved by leading with Relationship / Strategic Priorities and putting Restaurant Tech / Industry Signals after that. However, it still failed the full canonical RB CoS contract: no visible grounding labels, no stale-source warnings, no loops/overdue obligations, no what-to-ignore section, no explicit last-24h relationship-signal structure, and industry context remained too long relative to the relationship/action layer.
observed_issue: Default daily brief improved but remains a strategic advisory/news synthesis rather than the canonical RB operating brief.

defects.title: Default daily brief improved but still omits canonical sections
defects.description: The response now starts with relationship/strategic priorities and includes relevant industry context, but it omits required canonical sections: grounding labels, stale-source warnings, loops/obligations, what-to-ignore, reconciliation prompts, and explicit last-24h signal state.
defects.recommendation: Make the canonical daily brief structure API-rendered or enforce a stricter Custom GPT response template. The GPT should not be allowed to substitute a freeform strategic advisory essay for the operating brief.

defects.title: Industry section still overweight relative to relationship/action layer
defects.description: Industry context was relevant but too long compared with the relationship/action operating layer. NCR, Global Payments, PAR, AI discovery, and macro market read dominated much of the output.
defects.recommendation: Constrain industry context to a short relevance-filtered section with each item tied to active threads, specific relationships, job/consulting opportunities, or a clear action/monitor decision.

defects.title: Grounding labels still absent in default daily brief
defects.description: Despite the prompt and API updates, the default response did not visibly label items as system_detected, inferred, manual_user_provided, or stale_source_limited.
defects.recommendation: Move grounding labels into the API-rendered daily brief text or make them required fields in the response contract used by the GPT.

raw_text: Second default daily brief test showed progress: relationship/strategic priorities came first, with Maho/Ish Singh and RB 9.0 development direction. Industry context was relevant to restaurant tech and Todd's positioning, but remained too long and lacked explicit mapping to active threads/actions on each item. Missing: grounding labels, stale-source warnings, loops, what-to-ignore, reconciliation prompts, and explicit last-24h relationship-signal state.
